scope: offline long-term memory promotion provenance gate
root_cause_hypotheses: dataset_id labels can be duplicated across one fixture source hash and still satisfy min_distinct_datasets
the same evidence hash can be copied across sampling seeds and still satisfy min_sampling_seeds_per_dataset
repeated rows can inflate observation and accepted counts without adding independent evidence
interventions: Require a non-empty source hash and count distinct source hashes, not only dataset labels.
Deduplicate evidence hashes for observation, acceptance, and false-positive counts.
Require distinct evidence manifests across sampling seeds within each dataset and reject evidence reused across source hashes.
failure_conditions: one source with relabeled datasets promotes
same seed evidence manifest repeated across seeds promotes
a valid three-source ledger is quarantined without a provenance reason
